description: This file defines the interface 'DynamicallyFieldableEntityStorageSchemaInterface' for Drupal, which supports dynamic field definitions in entity storage schemas. It includes method signatures for schema change checks, data migration necessity, and cleanup after field data purge.

methods.name: requiresFieldStorageSchemaChanges
methods.description: Checks if changes to the storage definition require schema modifications.

methods.name: requiresFieldDataMigration
methods.description: Determines if existing data would be lost if schema changes are applied, indicating if data migration is needed.

methods.name: finalizePurge
methods.description: Performs cleanup after all data of a field has been purged.
